section.title: Basic settings
section.p: The cache holds 10 000 entries by default.

section.title: Tuning for large deployments
section.p: Raise the entry ceiling to 100 000 on hosts with more than 16 GB of memory.
Shorten the eviction interval to 10 seconds when the hit rate drops below 80 percent.

section.title: Monitoring
section.p: The hit rate is exported as cache.hit.ratio.
